title: test: preserve WSL import failure diagnostics
body:
## Summary
- Capture the decoded WSL2 import output, exit code, installer result, Windows/WSL versions, partial import files, and bounded WSL/Host Compute/Hyper-V events when the smoke-test distro import fails.
- Save diagnostics under `.build/logs/wsl-dev-container/` before cleanup removes the partial import, so existing CI logs artifacts preserve the evidence.
- Leave WSL installation, retry, and cleanup behavior unchanged.

Motivated by the [Windows Electron setup failure in build 476284](https://dev.azure.com/monacotools/a6d41577-0fa3-498e-af22-257312ff0545/_build/results?buildId=476284&view=logs&j=15ec5277-fdc6-550c-b203-acb65f44f31c&t=95193302-a421-588f-30a2-3600268fa4c0), where `wsl --import --version 2` returned `0x80041001` without enough evidence to identify the cause.

## Validation
- PowerShell parser reports no errors.
- Exercised `Write-WslDiagnostics` locally without importing a distro; verified the persisted log contains the required sections.
- `git diff --check` passed.

A Windows CI run is needed to validate the failure path on a hosted agent.
